verdict.rationale: Granola's first-party docs say it supports multiple languages for both transcription and generated summaries: 31 languages on desktop and 17 on mobile. That covers the core of the multilingual story. Nothing in the evidence shows handling of mid-meeting language switching or mixed-language meetings, which the story explicitly requires. Missing for 10: documented language-switching/code-switching support within a meeting, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-English transcription accuracy, and the full language list and parity between desktop and mobile.
